diagnosis: 022 did not capture a Bspline sample because /planning/bspline publisher creation is an init-time surface, while actual Bspline message publication occurs only after local rebound replanning succeeds. The 022 evidence shows a severe odometry/goal geometry mismatch and no log evidence that execution reached final_plan_success or bspline_pub_->publish().

ranked_causes.cause: Odometry z/scale/frame drift made the goal effectively kilometers away in the planner frame.
ranked_causes.details: Goal callback uses z=1.0 internally. With source odom z=-7241.161 m, the planner start-to-goal distance was about 7242.16 m, causing planGlobalTraj() to insert roughly 1810 intermediate points at the 4 m threshold.

ranked_causes.cause: Planner map bounds were incompatible with the observed odometry coordinates.
ranked_causes.details: The 022 config sets map_size_x/y/z=40/40/3 and ground_height=-0.01, so map boundaries are approximately x/y=[-20,20], z=[-0.01,2.99]. Observed odom x/y/z during planner window were far outside those bounds.

ranked_causes.cause: 022 log stops after Triggered! and lacks final_plan_success or Bspline publish evidence.
ranked_causes.details: Triggered! only proves waypointCallback entered. Bspline publication is in callReboundReplan() after planner_manager_->reboundReplan() returns true.

next_gate: Correct frame/scale/z before the next Bspline acceptance run; publish a real waypoint whose x/y/z are near the current odom and inside the EGO map envelope; stop after non-empty ego_planner_msgs/msg/Bspline echo or precise no-sample blocker.
